currency.basis: Commons upload dated 2022-05-05 matches the documented 2022 N26 rebrand; official n26.com was unreachable from this network (timeouts), so the official media-kit asset is unconfirmed and disclosed.

identity.basis: Source is the N26 wordmark of the 2022 identity; the base glyph represents the same mark in an outdated encircled variant.

assessment.independenceRationale: One third-party source; official-domain confirmation failed and is disclosed rather than implied.
uncertainties: Commons mirror provenance not independently verified; n26.com unreachable from this network.

variant.basis: Flat uncircled monochrome wordmark; letters form the mark itself, permitted for standalone icon cells.

candidate.detailsJudgement: The N with its over- and underbars, the 2 and 6 counters and all letterform details survive exactly; single flat fill, no gradients; fill value unchanged (#1B1B1B).
candidate.proportionsJudgement: Complete wordmark fits inside the circle with clearance at both themes; letterforms read clearly at 24/32/48 px diagnostics and in the 240px frames; the source aspect ratio is preserved (no distortion); alpha outside the circle and inside letter counters preserved.
candidate.rationale: Rebrand update: the accepted icon is the outdated encircled teal variant with a distorted N glyph; the current N26 identity (2022 refresh) is the flat monochrome #1B1B1B wordmark. The working version places the byte-preserved source wordmark on a plain white circular catalog backing for cross-theme legibility.
candidate.role: Standalone wordmark mark (letters form the mark itself) on a catalog-added plain white circular field; no official circular avatar of this exact variant was observed, so the circle is a catalog adaptation, not an official app icon.
transforms: Wordmark path copied byte-identically from the fetched source (single evenodd path, fill #1B1B1B).
Whole-emblem uniform scale 0.09 and centered translation place the complete wordmark inside a white circular catalog backing (circle r=27 at 54x54 cell center); no stretching, rotation or recoloring.

White backing added per plain-field circle policy: the source is a dark transparent mark that would be illegible on the #121212 dark theme; the white field preserves internal transparency of the mark itself.
SVGO 4.1.0 with frozen repo config: 1917 -> 1445 bytes; trial render pixel-identical to the working version on #FFFFFF and #121212 at 240px; optimized bytes selected.
candidate.variant: Current uncircled monochrome wordmark variant from the 2022 rebrand; source file is the flat mark on a transparent canvas.
candidate.visibleDiffExplanation: Accepted icon (teal circle, white distorted N glyph) versus current monochrome N26 wordmark on a white circular catalog backing: evidenced rebrand of the same bank, plus legibility repair. The difference is the entire point of the update, not a cosmetic serialization change.

proposals.reason: Current N26 identity is the 2022+ flat monochrome #1B1B1B 'N26' wordmark (N with bar above and below, '26' to the right). An original vector was fetched from Wikimedia Commons (upload dated 2022-05-05, matching the rebrand) and bound via source-material from the fetch receipt. The base icon is an outdated teal-circle variant with distorted white N glyph; the supported rebrand justifies the update.

sourceCandidate.rationale: Original vector of the current (2022+) wordmark, byte-identical material bound through source-material; supported rebrand of the same bank is the update reason.
